aegworldwide-aegworldwide:greenhouse:795.description: Company Information For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer. Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations. If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer! A Brief Overview The Box Office Attendant is responsible for assisting patrons with ticket distribution and providing general information pertaining to the venue or event. In addition to these general duties, the incumbent will provide direct support to the Box Office Manager and cover various tasks as needed. What you will do Assist customers with using ticketing software and ticket purchase through various methods; including cash, credit, and vouchers. Assist with will call and guest list management. Check identification, distribute tickets to the proper parties. Resolve issues as they arise and escalate concerns to management when necessary. Answer telephone inquiries related to show and ticket information. Provide guidance related to additional venue or event information, accessibility, ADA requests, etc. Accurately reconcile sales and will call receipts. Provide sales and ticketing information to the accounting and operations teams. Assist with show settlement as necessary Education Qualifications High School Diploma or its equivalency Experience Qualifications 0-2 years Of related work experience Skills and Abilities Must be available to work varied shifts which may include weekdays, weekends, evenings, and holidays Must have experience cash handling and other payment methods such as credit cards Must be proficient in Microsoft Office, specifically Excel and Word Excellent communication and customer service skills with a proven ability to work in a fast-paced environment Previous experience working in events and knowledge of the music industry preferred Previous experience working on a venue ticketing platform preferred Qualifications (ALL) High School Diploma or its equivalency 0-2 years Of related work experience Must be available to work varied shifts which may include weekdays, weekends, evenings, and holidays Must have experience cash handling and other payment methods such as credit cards Must be proficient in Microsoft Office, specifically Excel and Word Excellent communication and customer service skills with a proven ability to work in a fast-paced environment Previous experience working in events and knowledge of the music industry preferred Previous experience working on a venue ticketing platform preferred Payscale: Bonus: This position is not eligible for a bonus under the current bonus plan requirements. flagshippioneeringinc-flagshippioneering.title: Manager, Visual Design
flagshippioneeringinc-flagshippioneering.description: Flagship Pioneering is a scientific innovation engine that invents and builds companies that change the world. We bring together the greatest scientific minds with entrepreneurial company builders and assemble the capital to allow them to take courageous leaps in human health, sustainability, and beyond. What sets Flagship apart is our ability to advance biotechnology by uniting life science innovation, company creation, and capital investment under one roof in a way that is largely without precedent. Our team of scientists, entrepreneurial leaders, and professional capital managers are each aligned around an institutionalized process that enables us to innovate and create breakthroughs for the benefit of people and planet. Many of the companies Flagship has founded have addressed humanity’s most urgent challenges: vaccinating billions of people against COVID-19, curing intractable diseases, improving human health, preempting illness, and feeding the world by improving the resiliency and sustainability of agriculture. Flagship has been recognized twice on FORTUNE’s “Change the World” list, an annual ranking of companies that have made a positive social and environmental impact through activities that are part of their core business strategies, and has been named four times to Fast Company’s annual list of the World’s Most Innovative Companies. Position Overview Flagship Pioneering is seeking a highly creative Manager, Visual Design to elevate how we communicate our science, innovation model, and impact through compelling visual storytelling. This is a high-impact, individual contributor role that will lead the development and execution of presentation design, marketing collateral, brand assets, and visual materials across Flagship and its ecosystem. Working closely with Communications, Business Development, Investor Relations, Events, and senior leadership, this individual will transform complex scientific and business concepts into clear, visual narratives that that elevate understanding, strengthen Flagship's brand, and advance strategic priorities. The ideal candidate combines outstanding visual design skills with exceptional judgment, and proven experience utilizing new tools—including AI-powered creative technologies—to develop innovative communications experiences. This individual will have a strong portfolio showcasing their design expertise, exceptional creativity, and the ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment. Responsibilities Lead design, and execution of Flagship's visual communications across presentations, marketing collateral, digital assets, executive communications, events, and other internal and external materials, ensuring deliverables reflect the quality and innovation of the Flagship brand. Work with senior executives and cross-functional leaders to translate complex scientific, technical, and business concepts into compelling visual stories tailored to audiences, including investors, strategic partners, policymakers, prospective talent, employees, and the broader innovation ecosystem. Design and create engaging visual narratives across mediums, from presentations and interactive digital experiences to motion graphics, animation, reports, and emerging AI-enabled formats. Develop and evolve Flagship's visual design system by creating scalable presentation templates, graphic libraries, icons, illustrations, diagrams, animated assets, logos under the Flagship suite of brands, and other reusable assets that enable teams across the organization to create high-quality, on-brand materials efficiently and consistently. Serve as a visual design expert across the organization, providing hands-on execution and support to internal teams to determine the most effective visual approach for communicating ideas, initiatives, and complex information. jobgether-jobgether:lever:a60a7dbc-374b-.title: Pessoa Analista Fiscal Sr
jobgether-jobgether:lever:a60a7dbc-374b-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Pessoa Analista Fiscal Sr based in Brazil. This is a senior tax role with broad responsibility across direct and indirect taxation, tax compliance, and fiscal process improvement. You will act as a technical reference, helping translate complex tax legislation into practical business rules, processes, and ERP configurations. The position offers strong exposure to the Brazilian tax landscape, including the ongoing CBS/IBS Tax Reform and corporate tax requirements. You will also lead automation and continuous-improvement initiatives designed to make fiscal operations more efficient, accurate, and scalable. The role combines technical tax expertise with business partnering, audit support, and cross-functional collaboration. You’ll work in a fully remote, technology-driven environment that encourages curiosity, innovation, and the use of AI to modernize processes. This is an opportunity for an experienced tax professional to influence both compliance and the future of fiscal operations. Calculate, review, and validate direct taxes, including IRPJ and CSLL under the Lucro Real regime, LALUR, tax losses, and deferred taxes. Manage indirect taxation activities, including PIS/COFINS under cumulative and non-cumulative regimes, ISS, and withholding taxes. Prepare, review, and submit applicable ancillary tax obligations, including ECD, ECF, EFD-Contribuições, EFD-Reinf, DCTFWeb, DIRF, and related filings. Monitor taxation related to investments and equity interests, including JCP, dividends, capital gains, and withholding taxes such as IRRF. Act as a technical reference in the implementation of the Brazilian Tax Reform, particularly CBS and IBS, translating legislation into business rules and ERP configurations. Lead tax process automation and continuous-improvement initiatives by mapping current processes (AS IS), designing future-state processes (TO BE), and identifying opportunities to reduce manual work and risk. Monitor and support the use of Lei do Bem and other applicable tax incentives and benefits. Support external audits, prepare technical tax memoranda, and provide well-supported recommendations based on applicable legislation. Act as a tax business partner for business areas, helping stakeholders understand tax implications and make informed decisions. Serve as a technical reference and mentor for junior analysts and interns. Promote a digital mindset by exploring how AI, automation, and emerging technologies can improve tax processes, experiences, and business outcomes. Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting (Ciências Contábeis) or a related field. Solid experience in tax/fiscal functions within medium or large companies, holding companies, or Big Four environments. Strong knowledge of direct taxation and the Lucro Real regime. Strong knowledge of PIS/COFINS, including cumulative and non-cumulative regimes, ISS, withholding taxes, and Brazilian ancillary tax obligations. Practical knowledge of ECD, ECF, EFDs, DCTFWeb, and other relevant fiscal filings. Knowledge of the Brazilian Tax Reform, particularly CBS and IBS. Advanced Excel skills and experience working with corporate ERP systems such as Oracle or SAP. Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with a practical, solution-oriented approach to improving and modernizing processes. High technical rigor, attention to detail, and strong risk awareness, with recommendations grounded in applicable legislation. Interest in or practical knowledge of Artificial Intelligence technologies, tools, concepts, and business applications. Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to act as a trusted technical partner across different business areas. Proactive, curious, adaptable, and comfortable working in a technology-driven environment. Benefits: 100% remote Anywhere Office work model. Meal and food allowance.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:b1173a64-f88c-.title: Influencer Marketing Account Manager
jobgether-jobgether:lever:b1173a64-f88c-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Influencer Marketing Account Manager based in Switzerland. This role offers the opportunity to manage international influencer marketing campaigns from planning through execution and performance analysis. You will serve as a key point of contact for creators while ensuring campaigns remain organized, on-brand, and aligned with client objectives. The position combines account management, creator relations, content quality control, campaign operations, and data analysis. You will work across multiple campaigns and markets, identifying opportunities to improve performance and build stronger creator partnerships. Your attention to detail will be essential when reviewing content, tracking deliverables, and maintaining accurate campaign information. The role is well suited to an organized, analytical professional who enjoys working with influencers, data, and fast-moving digital marketing campaigns. You will also have the opportunity to discover high-performing creators and contribute to the growth of international influencer programs. Manage day-to-day communication and relationships with international influencers and content creators. Coordinate influencer marketing campaigns from initial planning through execution, publication, and performance reporting. Review and approve creator content before publication, ensuring compliance with campaign guidelines, brand requirements, and quality standards. Monitor key campaign metrics including engagement, clicks, conversions, promotional codes, and overall performance. Maintain accurate and up-to-date campaign information across Monday.com, Salesforce, HubSpot, Google Sheets, and similar tools. Identify high-performing influencers and analyze campaign results to uncover opportunities for optimization and future collaborations. Research, approach, evaluate, and recruit new creators who align with client objectives, audiences, and campaign requirements. Track campaign deliverables, deadlines, creator commitments, and other operational requirements. Prepare performance reports and provide ongoing updates on campaign progress and results. Identify content errors, inconsistencies, or process gaps and take appropriate action to maintain campaign quality. Manage multiple campaigns and priorities simultaneously while maintaining strong organization and attention to detail. Requirements 2–4 years of professional experience in influencer marketing, account management, digital marketing, or a related field. Strong understanding of influencer marketing campaigns, creator partnerships, engagement, conversions, and performance metrics. Professional or advanced English proficiency, both written and conversational. Experience using project management, CRM, or campaign management platforms such as Monday.com, Salesforce, HubSpot, Google Sheets, or comparable tools. Excellent organizational skills and strong attention to detail. Ability to identify errors, inconsistencies, and potential issues in content, campaign tracking, and operational processes. Strong analytical and results-oriented mindset, with the ability to interpret campaign metrics and translate insights into actionable improvements. Excellent communication and relationship-management skills when working with influencers, clients, and internal stakeholders. Ability to work independently, prioritize effectively, and manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment. Availability to work according to a Cyprus-based schedule, Sunday through Thursday, starting at 9:30 a.m. EEST. Willingness to sign confidentiality agreements when required. Ability to align professional social media profiles with client projects when necessary. Reliable internet connection and an appropriate home working environment. Benefits 100% remote working arrangement. Opportunity to work on international influencer marketing campaigns. Exposure

jobgether-jobgether:lever:b5979c80-26c0-.title: Research Engineer (Reinforcement Learning)
jobgether-jobgether:lever:b5979c80-26c0-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Research Engineer (Reinforcement Learning) based in Netherlands. Join a small, senior engineering team building the next generation of voice- and text-driven AI agents. You’ll focus on post-training models to make agents more capable, reliable, and effective over long-running interactions. Your work will span environments, verifiers, synthetic data, training experiments, evaluations, and production deployment. You’ll tackle challenging problems such as persistent context, reliable tool use, and multi-turn agent behavior. The role combines hands-on research and engineering, with a strong emphasis on measurable improvements in model performance. You’ll work closely with experienced engineers in a remote, collaborative environment where technical craft and creativity are highly valued. Your contributions will directly shape AI systems operating at significant production scale. Build training environments, verifiers, and supporting infrastructure for post-training models. Own the synthetic data pipeline from data generation through quality assurance and validation. Run end-to-end training experiments, analyze results, and clearly identify the factors driving model improvements. Design and maintain evaluations that models must pass before production releases. Select and adapt suitable open-weight foundation models for specific agent and product requirements. Develop trained behaviors that perform consistently across both voice and text-based agents. Deploy trained models to production and continuously improve them based on real-world usage and feedback. Develop robust approaches to long-horizon interactions, accumulated context, and reliable tool use during live conversations. Requirements: Strong Python engineering skills and the ability to build reliable, production-quality systems. Demonstrated experience taking a machine learning model from raw data through experimentation and into production. A strong data-centric mindset, with attention to coverage, diversity, quality, and data leakage. The ability to anticipate reward exploitation and design robust rewards, verifiers, and evaluation mechanisms. Practical experience working with GPUs and a realistic understanding of their capabilities and limitations. Strong judgment around when model training is the right solution—and when a simpler approach is preferable. Ability to collaborate effectively within a remote, distributed, and highly autonomous team. Experience with post-training techniques such as fine-tuning, reward design, or reinforcement learning, including approaches such as GRPO, is highly desirable. Familiarity with RL and fine-tuning frameworks such as TRL, verl, OpenRLHF, or custom training loops is a plus. Experience with technologies such as vLLM or SGLang for fast rollouts and FSDP for multi-GPU training is advantageous. Experience training tool-using or multi-turn agents, as well as building execution sandboxes, verifiers, evaluation harnesses, or developer tooling, is valuable. Familiarity with open-weight model families such as Qwen or Llama and techniques such as LoRA is a plus. Benefits: Opportunity to make a significant impact on a fast-growing developer platform and help shape its future. Collaboration with a small, highly experienced team that values technical excellence, creativity, and ownership. Competitive salary and equity package. Health, dental, and vision benefits. Flexible vacation policy. Remote-friendly working environment with flexibility and autonomy. spmb-spmb:lever:24371626-9ef9-4023-96cf-.title: Analyst (People and Market Research) - Denver
spmb-spmb:lever:24371626-9ef9-4023-96cf-.description: About Us SPMB is a leading executive search firm at the heart of the innovation economy. We partner with transformative companies and investors to build the leadership teams that shape the future. For over 40 years, we’ve connected visionary executives with high-impact organizations across technology, financial services, consumer, media, health, and sustainability sectors. We combine the strategic reach of a global search firm with the agility and care of a boutique partnership. Our team closes hundreds of C-level and Board searches each year for the fastest-growing and most iconic companies in the world. These organizations have collectively generated more than $1 trillion in market value through IPOs and M&As. What truly sets SPMB apart is our culture. We’re a collaborative community of curious, driven people who believe in “We vs. I.” We challenge each other to work right, work together, and work smart that empowers everyone to grow, make an impact, and help shape the next generation of leadership. For more information, visit our website at https://spmb.com/ Position Overview As an Analyst at SPMB, you’ll be part of the engine that drives our client success, combining research, technology, and human insight to help build the leadership teams powering the world’s most innovative companies. This role offers an unparalleled opportunity to learn how successful leaders and organizations are built. You’ll collaborate with experienced search professionals and directly engage with senior executives, founders, and investors across venture capital, private equity, and public company ecosystems. We’re looking for curious problem-solvers who want their work to matter; people who take ownership, think critically, and embrace technology (including AI and large language models) to deepen insight and accelerate results. You’ll develop deep expertise in market dynamics, leadership trends, and organizational strategy while working in a culture that values continuous learning, teamwork, and purpose-driven impact. If you’re energized by discovery, driven by results, and ready to help shape the future of leadership, this is where your journey begins.

weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:c4be4ad6-47c.description: Welo Data is an award-winning localization and data transformation company. We run one of the world’s largest Ads Rating Programs and we want you to join! As an Ads Quality Rater, you will review and grade internet advertisements to help shape how ads are delivered to the end users. In other words, you’ll tell the AI program how good or bad its advertisement suggestions are based on the user’s keywords. You will review ads in both English and Bulgarian This role is great for people who: - Surf the internet daily - Use major search engines frequently - Know what people want based on a few keywords - Enjoy researching topics online - Want a flexible and fun side job Project Details Job Title: Ads Quality Rater Pay Rate: Based on tasks (approximately $7 per hour) Location: Remote/work from home - must be based in Bulgaria Hours: Set your schedule based on the following – Minimum commitment is 5 hours per week. You can choose to work up to 20 hours per week. Start Date: ASAP Employment Type: Independent Contractor/Freelance/Self-Employed Project Duration: Long-term Note: - Even though the position is WFH, you must reside in the country that is noted in this description. This will be automatically checked during the hiring process. Recruitment Process - There is no formal interview for this job! No phone calls, no waiting, and no wasting time wondering whether you got the job or not. - Instead, you will be guided through a self-paced and automated recruitment process.
